services_offered_title: Food Safety and SFA Compliance Advisory
services_offered_description: Specialist advisory for food businesses seeking to improve NEA/SFA grading outcomes and maintain licence compliance. Services include on-site hygiene assessments, gap analysis against regulatory standards, staff training on food handling procedures, and corrective action plan development. Particular experience with central kitchens, food manufacturing facilities, and catering operations. Deliverables tailored to client needs - from quick remediation reports to full HACCP plan development.
relevant_experience: 12 years in food safety regulatory roles with SFA and NEA before transitioning to private advisory. Assisted over 30 SME food businesses achieve Grade A ratings and resolve licensing compliance issues. Former lead inspector for central kitchen assessments. Familiar with GHP, GMP, and HACCP requirements under the Sale of Food Act.

services_offered_title: Construction Claims Preparation and Dispute Advisory
services_offered_description: Independent advisory for contractors and subcontractors dealing with disputed variation orders, prolongation claims, and final account disagreements. Services include review of contract documents and site records, claim quantification, preparation of formal claim submissions, and support through adjudication and mediation. Familiar with SIA, REDAS, PSSCOC, and NEC contract forms.
relevant_experience: 18 years as a quantity surveyor specialising in construction disputes. Has represented subcontractors and main contractors in over 40 adjudication and mediation proceedings in Singapore. Previously with a specialist claims consultancy. Certified Adjudicator under the Singapore Mediation Centre.

services_offered_title: AML/CFT Compliance Advisory for MAS-Regulated Entities
services_offered_description: Compliance advisory specialising in MAS regulatory requirements for payment institutions, capital markets intermediaries, and digital payment token service providers. Services include AML/CFT framework reviews, policy development, gap analysis, and regulatory correspondence support. Up-to-date with all MAS Notice amendments under the Payment Services Act.
relevant_experience: 14 years in financial crime compliance, including 6 years at MAS as an examiner covering payment institutions. Subsequently held Head of Compliance roles at two licensed fintech companies. Deep familiarity with PSA licensing requirements and MAS AML/CFT supervisory expectations.

services_offered_title: Interim CFO and Financial Controller Services for Listed SMEs
services_offered_description: Interim financial leadership for Singapore-listed and pre-IPO companies requiring experienced financial management on a temporary basis. Services cover full financial close and reporting, board and audit committee support, external auditor liaison, and SGX continuing obligation compliance. Comfortable stepping in at short notice and maintaining continuity through a leadership transition.
relevant_experience: 22 years in finance including CFO roles at two SGX Mainboard and one Catalist listed companies. CPA (Singapore). Extensive experience with SFRS, SGX listing rules, and Audit Committee governance. Has successfully managed three interim mandates between permanent CFO appointments.

services_offered_title: Cybersecurity Risk Assessment and Advisory for SMEs
services_offered_description: Practical cybersecurity risk assessments for small and mid-size businesses that have grown their digital footprint without a dedicated IT security function. Services include review of cloud configuration, access controls, data protection practices, and third-party SaaS risk. Produces business-friendly risk reports suitable for sharing with insurers, boards, and regulators.
relevant_experience: 15 years in IT and cybersecurity, the last 8 focused on advisory for SMEs across logistics, professional services, and retail. Familiar with Microsoft 365 security configurations and the Cyber Essentials framework. Has produced insurer-facing risk reports for over 25 SME clients.

services_offered_title: Medical Clinic Operations and Billing Process Improvement
services_offered_description: Operational improvement for GP clinics, specialist practices, and day surgery centres. Focus areas include patient billing workflow redesign, insurance claim rejection reduction, practice management system optimisation, and front office productivity. Familiar with Clinic Assist, iClinic, and Plato practice management systems.
relevant_experience: 12 years in healthcare operations including 7 years managing billing and operations for a group of GP clinics. Reduced insurance claim rejection rates from 18% to under 4% in previous engagement. Experience with CHAS, Medisave, and private insurance billing in Singapore.

services_offered_title: M&E and Mechanical Engineering Due Diligence for Acquisitions
services_offered_description: Independent technical assessments for buyers and investors evaluating engineering services businesses, contractors, and facilities management companies. Scope includes technical capability evaluation, key person risk analysis, equipment condition assessment, regulatory licence verification (BCA, BizSAFE, NEA), and material technical risk identification.
relevant_experience: 20 years in mechanical and electrical engineering including project management of ACMV, plumbing, and fire protection systems for commercial and industrial buildings. Last 6 years focused on technical due diligence for SME acquisitions. Holds PE registration with PEB Singapore.

services_offered_title: Food Manufacturing Cost Optimisation and Production Planning
services_offered_description: Advisory for food producers and caterers looking to improve production efficiency, reduce ingredient wastage, and manage food cost ratios. Services include production workflow analysis, yield loss identification, procurement strategy review, supplier negotiation support, and portion control system design. Covers cold chain and storage optimisation for perishable ingredients.
relevant_experience: 16 years in food manufacturing operations including plant manager roles at two contract food manufacturers in Singapore and Malaysia. Has reduced food cost ratios by an average of 6-9 percentage points across five client engagements.

services_offered_title: Marine Environmental Compliance and Pollution Control Advisory
services_offered_description: Technical advisory for shipyards, vessel operators, and marine facilities on environmental compliance with MPA, NEA, and MARPOL requirements. Services include discharge standard compliance review, oil-water separator performance assessment, bilge water management system audit, and preparation of technical reports for regulatory submissions.
relevant_experience: 18 years in marine and offshore engineering with specialisation in environmental systems. Previously senior engineer at a classification society covering environmental compliance for Singapore-flagged vessels. Has produced expert technical opinions for MPA submissions. Familiar with API separator design standards and common failure modes in ship repair yard environments.

services_offered_title: Workplace Safety Management System Development for SMEs
services_offered_description: Practical workplace safety and health advisory for manufacturing and construction SMEs seeking BizSAFE certification or WSH audit compliance. Services include risk assessment facilitation, Risk Management Implementation Plan development, safety documentation preparation, and audit readiness support. Focus on hands-on implementation rather than training slides.
relevant_experience: 14 years as a WSH Officer and safety consultant. Helped precision engineering, food manufacturing, and construction firms achieve BizSAFE Level 3 and Star certification. Guided over 60 SMEs through WSH council audits with a first-attempt pass rate above 90%. Registered WSH Officer with MOM.

services_offered_title: Technology Expert Witness and IT Project Dispute Advisory
services_offered_description: Independent expert services for legal proceedings involving technology project failures, software delivery disputes, and IT contract disagreements. Provides technical analysis of software requirements, delivery records, and industry-standard development practices. Produces formal expert witness reports meeting Singapore court requirements and available to give oral evidence.
relevant_experience: 20 years in software development and IT project management. Last 7 years focused on expert witness and dispute advisory work. Has produced expert reports in over 15 Singapore court and arbitration proceedings covering software delivery failures and system integration disputes.

services_offered_title: Deep Tech Commercialisation and Technology Transfer Advisory
services_offered_description: Advisory for research institutions, spinoffs, and IP owners seeking to convert laboratory results into commercial opportunities. Services include commercial pathway assessment, IP strategy review, market entry analysis, investor readiness preparation, and partnership structuring. Experience with A*STAR, NRF, and university spinoff ecosystems. Familiar with materials science, biotech, and sustainable packaging technology sectors.
relevant_experience: 19 years spanning R&D management at A*STAR and commercialisation advisory for technology spinoffs. Has structured licensing agreements and joint ventures for 12 Singapore-based deep tech companies. Led technology transfer for three A*STAR-funded projects that resulted in commercial manufacturing agreements.

services_offered_title: Franchise Agreement Advisory and F&B Franchise Operations Consulting
services_offered_description: Commercial advisory for businesses entering franchise arrangements. Services include commercial review of franchise agreements (territory, royalties, exit provisions, exclusivity), operational feasibility assessment, and briefing support for legal counsel. Practical expertise in the F&B franchise sector with direct experience operating and advising franchise businesses in Singapore and the region.
relevant_experience: 16 years in F&B operations and franchise development. Previously regional franchise development manager for an international QSR brand. Subsequently advised over 20 SME franchisees on agreement evaluation and renegotiation. Understands the operational realities behind franchise contract terms.

services_offered_title: Cold Chain Logistics Setup and Food Distribution Advisory
services_offered_description: Operational advisory for food businesses adding chilled or frozen distribution capability. Services include cold room specification, transport refrigeration assessment, SFA cold chain licensing guidance, HACCP plan development for temperature-sensitive products, and indicative capital cost estimation. Experience with seafood, dairy, meat, and prepared food distribution.
relevant_experience: 15 years in food logistics and cold chain operations including operations manager at a mid-size chilled seafood distributor supplying Singapore supermarkets. Has helped three SME food businesses successfully enter chilled distribution from a fresh or ambient starting point.

services_offered_title: Business Plan and Financial Modelling for SME Financing
services_offered_description: Preparation of business plans, financial projections, and financing documents for SMEs seeking bank loans, government grants, or investor funding. Services include historical financial analysis, 3-5 year projection modelling, sensitivity analysis, and narrative business plan writing. Familiar with requirements of Singapore banks, ESG grant applications, and EDB documentation.
relevant_experience: 13 years in corporate finance and SME advisory. Background includes credit analysis at a Singapore bank and 8 years of independent advisory helping SMEs across retail, F&B, and services sectors. Has supported over 80 successful loan applications totalling more than SGD 45 million.

services_offered_title: Marine Vessel Safety Management System Auditing
services_offered_description: ISM Code compliance auditing and safety management system review for vessel owners and operators. Services include SMS gap analysis, drill and record-keeping compliance review, pre-inspection readiness assessment, and corrective action support. Experience with MPA surveys, class society audits, and flag state inspections for Singapore-registered vessels.
relevant_experience: 22 years in marine operations and safety management including senior officer roles on offshore support vessels and bulk carriers. Last 9 years focused on SMS auditing and ISM compliance advisory for Singapore-based vessel owners. Master Mariner certificate of competency.

services_offered_title: HR Systems Implementation and Employment Compliance for SMEs
services_offered_description: End-to-end HR system selection and implementation for growing SMEs, including payroll system setup, leave management configuration, and employment contract review. Familiar with Talenox, Infotech, and QuickHR platforms. Also covers Employment Act compliance, MOM requirements, and basic HR policy documentation.
relevant_experience: 11 years in HR operations including HR manager roles at two Singapore retail and F&B groups. Has implemented Talenox at four SME clients and Infotech at two others. Familiar with MOM Employment Act requirements and CPF contribution obligations for different employment categories.

services_offered_title: Healthcare Clinic Operations Consulting and Branch Expansion Planning
services_offered_description: Operational advisory for clinics and allied health practices planning to expand or improve operational efficiency. Services include patient flow analysis, scheduling optimisation, inventory and consumables management review, staffing model design, and branch setup planning. Experience with TCM, physiotherapy, and dental practice operational models in Singapore.
relevant_experience: 14 years in healthcare operations with specific experience in TCM and allied health clinic management. Has managed the operational launch of four new clinic branches across two healthcare groups. Familiar with MOH licensing requirements for TCM practitioners.

services_offered_title: Executive HR Advisory and Senior Talent Acquisition for SMEs
services_offered_description: Strategic HR advisory for SME founders on building their management layer - defining senior roles, structuring competitive compensation packages, and attracting experienced professionals to growing businesses. Also covers performance management framework design and leadership development for first-time managers. Not focused on administrative HR, documentation, or payroll.
relevant_experience: 18 years as an HR professional including CHRO roles at two Singapore SMEs that scaled to 200+ staff. Specialises in the people challenges of fast-growing businesses. Has placed over 50 senior hires at SGD 100k+ salary levels.

services_offered_title: Digital Marketing Strategy and Social Media Growth for SMEs
services_offered_description: Digital marketing advisory for SMEs seeking to grow their online presence through social media, content marketing, and paid digital advertising. Services include social media strategy, content calendar development, Instagram and Facebook campaign management, and performance analytics. Not specialist in review management or crisis communications.
relevant_experience: 10 years in digital marketing including agency experience managing social media and digital campaigns for F&B, retail, and lifestyle brands in Singapore. Has grown Instagram followings from under 1,000 to over 50,000 for three SME clients.

services_offered_title: AI Chatbot Development and Deployment for SME Customer Service
services_offered_description: Design, build, and deployment of AI-powered chatbots for SMEs looking to automate customer service interactions across WhatsApp, website, and messaging platforms. Services include requirements scoping, chatbot flow design, LLM integration, API connection to existing e-commerce or CRM platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce), testing, and live deployment. Focus on practical, maintainable solutions rather than over-engineered systems.
relevant_experience: 9 years in software development with the last 5 focused on conversational AI and chatbot implementation for SME and mid-market clients. Has deployed WhatsApp Business API chatbots for e-commerce, F&B, and hospitality clients in Singapore and the region. Familiar with OpenAI, Twilio, and Meta Business API integration.

services_offered_title: AI-Assisted Document Processing and Workflow Automation Advisory
services_offered_description: Advisory and implementation for professional services firms seeking to use AI tools to reduce manual document handling. Services include process mapping of document-heavy workflows, evaluation and selection of AI document processing tools (OCR, NLP, LLM-based extraction), prototype development, and implementation roadmap production. Experience with legal, financial, and compliance document workflows in regulated environments.
relevant_experience: 12 years in business process automation and enterprise software, with the last 4 years focused on AI-assisted document processing for professional services firms. Has evaluated and implemented document AI solutions for law firms, accounting practices, and financial institutions in Singapore. Familiar with data protection obligations under PDPA.

services_offered_title: Industry 4.0 Advisory and Smart Manufacturing Feasibility Assessment
services_offered_description: Feasibility assessment and implementation advisory for manufacturers considering Industry 4.0 technology investments - sensor integration, IoT monitoring, data analytics, and computer vision quality inspection. Services include production line assessment, technology option evaluation, vendor shortlisting, and business case development. Focus on right-sized solutions for SME manufacturers, not enterprise-scale deployments.
relevant_experience: 14 years in manufacturing operations and industrial technology, including plant management and operational excellence roles at precision engineering and electronics manufacturers in Singapore. Last 5 years focused on Industry 4.0 advisory for SMEs considering their first significant technology investment. Familiar with EDB Smart Industry Readiness Index framework.

services_offered_title: SME Business Sale and Acquisition Advisory (Sell-Side)
services_offered_description: End-to-end advisory for SME founders and family business owners looking to sell their business or find a strategic partner. Services include business valuation, information memorandum preparation, buyer identification and approach, negotiation support, and term sheet review. Experience with food, manufacturing, services, and distribution businesses in Singapore and the region. Works alongside existing legal advisors - does not duplicate legal services.
relevant_experience: 17 years in corporate finance and M&A including managing director roles at two boutique M&A advisory firms. Has advised on over 35 completed SME transactions in Singapore and Southeast Asia, primarily in the SGD 5M-50M range. Extensive network of strategic and financial buyers active in the Singapore SME market.

services_offered_title: Healthcare Sector M&A Advisory and Target Identification
services_offered_description: Buy-side advisory for healthcare operators and investors seeking acquisition targets in the Singapore and regional healthcare market. Services include target identification and preliminary screening, initial financial and operational assessment, approach strategy, and indicative valuation. Particular experience with dental, GP clinic, and allied health practice transactions. Works with clients who do not have dedicated M&A resources internally.
relevant_experience: 15 years in healthcare management and corporate development, including head of corporate development roles at two Singapore healthcare groups. Has evaluated over 40 potential clinic acquisitions and completed 8 transactions in the dental and GP clinic sectors. Understands both the operational and financial dimensions of healthcare SME acquisitions.

services_offered_title: Post-Merger Integration and Business Combination Advisory
services_offered_description: Advisory for businesses that have completed a merger or acquisition and need help integrating two organisations - aligning processes, systems, culture, and commercial operations. Services include integration planning, workstream management, change management support, and progress reporting to leadership and investors. Not focused on operational restructuring of a single business or JV exit situations.
relevant_experience: 16 years in management consulting and corporate development with specialisation in post-merger integration. Has led integration programmes for 12 completed transactions in financial services, logistics, and professional services. Familiar with both acquirer and target perspectives in integration processes.

services_offered_title: Social Programme Evaluation and Impact Measurement for Charities and NPOs
services_offered_description: Independent evaluation services for charities, VWOs, and social service agencies seeking to measure the effectiveness of their programmes. Services include evaluation framework design, data collection instrument development, beneficiary survey coordination, outcomes analysis, and report writing for donor and regulatory reporting. Familiar with NCSS requirements and MOE programme evaluation standards.
relevant_experience: 13 years in social research and programme evaluation, including senior roles at two Singapore social service agencies and independent evaluation work for charities supported by Community Chest and other major donors. Has designed and conducted outcomes evaluations for youth, elder, and disability programmes. Familiar with theory of change and logic model frameworks.

services_offered_title: Community Needs Assessment and Social Survey Research
services_offered_description: Research and survey services for social service organisations, government agencies, and community groups seeking to understand the needs of a defined population. Services include survey methodology design, questionnaire development, volunteer coordinator briefing, data collection management, statistical analysis, and report writing for funding applications and strategic planning. Experience with elderly, low-income, and vulnerable population groups.
relevant_experience: 11 years in social research and community development, including research manager roles at two Singapore research consultancies serving public sector and social service clients. Has conducted community needs assessments for Town Councils, VWOs, and statutory boards. Familiar with the Singapore social service landscape and funding body reporting requirements.

services_offered_title: Vocational Training Programme Design and Evaluation
services_offered_description: Design, review, and evaluation of vocational and skills training programmes for training providers, social enterprises, and employers. Services include curriculum review against industry skills frameworks, assessment design, training effectiveness evaluation, and trainer capability assessment. Familiar with SSG framework requirements and WSQ certification processes. Also covers job placement process design and employer partnership development.
relevant_experience: 14 years in workforce development and adult education, including training manager and curriculum designer roles at two Singapore Approved Training Organisations. Has reviewed and redesigned vocational programmes for F&B, cleaning, and retail sectors. Familiar with SSG audit requirements and WSQ certification processes.

services_offered_title: Charity Annual Report Design and Content Production
services_offered_description: Design and production of annual reports, donor reports, and impact publications for charities and non-profit organisations. Services include content writing from client-provided data, infographic and layout design, photography coordination, and print-ready PDF production. Focus on making complex programme data visually accessible to a non-specialist donor audience. Does not include programme evaluation, outcomes measurement, or data analysis.
relevant_experience: 8 years in communications and publication design for the non-profit and social service sector in Singapore. Has produced annual reports and donor publications for over 20 charities and VWOs. Familiar with NCSS and Commissioner of Charities reporting presentation requirements. Proficient in Adobe InDesign and Canva for non-profit design work.
